purpose: FOUR-ROW SMOKE for SAEA-SLURP-DEV1000-CLOSED-LIST-LOGPROB-V1. Same baseline fragment, same model fragment, same dataset fragment, same arm, same packets, same instruction -- four samples instead of one thousand. It exists to prove ONE thing a contact-free wire check cannot: that the pinned llama-server actually returns a choices[0].logprobs object on the SPEECH-FEATURE PACKET route, with five alternatives per generated token, and that the MODEL_LOGPROBS trace record lands. The source reading says it must (logprobs are computed in the token-generation loop from the target context's logits, downstream of every prompt-construction path, packet or mmproj), but the 2026-08-13 policy note already records llama-server sometimes omitting usable logprobs for a hypothesis, and an absent object is treated as 'unavailable' rather than a crash -- so it is checked with four rows before 1,000 are spent. Its own exposure row, its own run id, its own attempt accounting; its numbers are a wiring proof and are never reported as a result.

populations.basis: The SAME four ids the closed-list direct smoke named (configs/experiment/slurp-dev1000-closed-list-direct-smoke-v1.json): the first four DEV-1000 sample ids in sorted order, named HERE in the registered fragment so a smoke can never quietly fly four different rows than the ones its exposure row names.

acceptance: The smoke passes when all four rows return a choices[0].logprobs object, every generated token carries a top_logprobs list of exactly five entries whose first entry is the sampled token, and four MODEL_LOGPROBS records land in the trace with recomputable logprobs_sha256 and requested_top_logprobs 5. It fails -- and the 1,000-row cell does not fly -- if any row returns no object, or if the alternatives are truncated below five on a token whose vocabulary could supply them.
budget_basis: 4 contacts plus margin for one permitted recovery within the same run id = 12 planned model calls, matching the closed-list direct smoke. The four rows' own audio is 14.28 seconds; 60 is the rounded ceiling. GPU hours 0.3 covers a cold model load plus four contacts. Paid API spend 0. Plan cells are RUN-CUMULATIVE across every attempt of this run id.
